notablePrerequisites: Empowered Autogenerator has at least one charge counter on it.
description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least {U}{U}.
Activate Manifold Key by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Empowered Autogenerator.
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding {U} for each charge counter on it.
Activate Drafna's first ability by paying {1}{U}, returning Manifold Key from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Manifold Key by paying {1}.
Repeat from step 2.
